svg.title: Doctor in the osf CLI
svg.desc: The new doctor module sits between the CLI and the existing config, agents, githooks and reviewers modules, and observes the repository and machine without writing to them.

g.text: EXISTING OSF MODULES · CONFIG, AGENTS, GITHOOKS,…
